title: The Bridegroom Praises the Bride

questions.question: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Your eyes are doves behind your what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:1 (ESV): "Your eyes are doves behind your veil."

questions.question: Your hair is like a flock of what leaping down the slopes of Gilead?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:1 (ESV): "Your hair is like a flock of goats,"

questions.question: Your teeth are like a flock of what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:2 (ESV): "Your teeth are like a flock of shorn sheep,"

questions.question: You are altogether beautiful, my love; there is no what in you?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:7 (ESV): "there is no flaw in you."

questions.question: You have captivated my heart, my sister, my what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:9 (ESV): "You have captivated my heart, my sister, my bride;"

questions.question: Your lips are like a scarlet thread, and your mouth is what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:3 (ESV): "Your lips are like a scarlet thread, and your mouth is lovely."

questions.question: Your neck is like the tower of whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:4 (ESV): "Your neck is like the tower of David,"

questions.question: Until the day breathes and the shadows flee, I will get me to the mountain of what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:6 (ESV): "I will get me to the mountain of myrrh"

questions.question: Come with me from where, my bride?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:8 (ESV): "Come with me from Lebanon, my bride;"

questions.question: How much better is your love than wine, and the fragrance of your oils than any what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:10 (ESV): "and the fragrance of your oils than any spice!"

questions.question: Your cheeks are like halves of a what behind your veil?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:3 (ESV): "Your cheeks are like halves of a pomegranate behind your veil."

questions.question: Upon the tower of David hang a thousand what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:4 (ESV): "built in rows of stone; on it hang a thousand shields,"

questions.question: depart from the peak of Amana, from the peak of Senir and what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:8 (ESV): "from the peak of Senir and Hermon,"

questions.question: A garden locked is my sister, my bride, a spring locked, a fountain what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:12 (ESV): "a spring locked, a fountain sealed."

questions.question: Awake, O north wind, and come, O south wind! Blow upon my what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 4:16 (ESV): "Blow upon my garden, let its spices flow."

key_verse_text: You are altogether beautiful, my love; there is no flaw in you.
